cards.name: Ensnare
cards.oracleText:
You may return two Islands you control to their owner's hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Tap all creatures.

cards.name: Ensnaring Bridge
cards.oracleText: Creatures with power greater than the number of cards in your hand can't attack.

cards.name: Ensnared by the Mara
cards.oracleText: Each opponent faces a villainous choice — They exile cards from the top of their library until they exile a nonland card, then you may cast that card without paying its mana cost, or that player exiles the top four cards of their library and Ensnared by the Mara deals damage equal to the total mana value of those exiled cards to that player.
